Troubleshoot

If something breaks, start here.

1. Clone request fails

Check that your audio is clear, contains one speaker, and is long enough to capture a stable voice profile.

2. Upload finishes but processing does not continue

Retry on a stable connection and confirm the selected file is a supported audio, video, or document format.

3. Generated speech sounds off

Review punctuation, spacing, unusual abbreviations, and source text formatting before generating again.

4. Subtitle generation times out or fails

Make sure the video is 30 seconds or shorter and has clear, audible speech. Very quiet or heavily accented audio can take longer to process.

5. Document import doesn't detect chapters correctly

Make sure your EPUB or DOCX file uses standard chapter headings. Documents without clear structure may be imported as a single section.

6. AI Assistant gives no response

Check your connection and try again. If you selected a provider that requires a Pro subscription, you'll be prompted to upgrade instead.

7. App feels stuck or outdated

Close and reopen the app, refresh your session if available, and make sure you are on the latest build.

8. Still blocked

Use the Contact page with a short issue summary, affected feature, and any visible error text.
